card.name: Comma after dose frequency phrases
card.fires_on: The comma right after a dosing phrase such as 'once daily' or 'twice daily' or after a dose amount, just before timing details. Also fires on scattered technical spots like a date or fstab column header.

modes.label: Comma after dose schedule
modes.description: A comma following 'once daily', 'twice daily' or a dose amount, before timing like 'morning and evening'.
modes.example: Instill the contents of one single-dose CLOTIC vial into the affected ear canal twice daily<<,>> morning and evening, preferably 12

modes.label: Comma after a setting value
modes.description: A comma after a pressure or similar value in procedure instructions, before the next setting.

modes.label: Technical text oddities
modes.description: Pieces of code, config or date formats in web text, such as a column name or a digit in a date.

card.plain: It fires on the comma after a dosing frequency like 'once daily', where timing details usually come next.
